Topics · Is there a God?

Is there a sign of God inside me?

The Quran says to look inward too, and names love, sleep and conscience. Here is how to test it yourself.

Part 1 of 4

﴿وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ٢٠ وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ٢١﴾

Translation of the meaning

And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith] And in yourselves. Then will you not see?

Quran · Adh-Dhariyat 51:20-21

Translation

For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, even his everlasting power and divinity, that they may be without excuse. Because knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, and didn’t give thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and their senseless heart was darkened. Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools, and traded the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds, four-footed animals, and creeping things.

Original · Ancient Greek

τὰ γὰρ ἀόρατα αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ κτίσεως κόσμου τοῖς ποιήμασιν νοούμενα καθορᾶται, ἥ τε ἀΐδιος αὐτοῦ δύναμις καὶ θειότης, εἰς τὸ εἶναι αὐτοὺς ἀναπολογήτους, διότι γνόντες τὸν θεὸν οὐχ ὡς θεὸν ἐδόξασαν ἢ ηὐχαρίστησαν, ἀλλὰ ἐματαιώθησαν ἐν τοῖς διαλογισμοῖς αὐτῶν καὶ ἐσκοτίσθη ἡ ἀσύνετος αὐτῶν καρδία· φάσκοντες εἶναι σοφοὶ ἐμωράνθησαν, καὶ ἤλλαξαν τὴν δόξαν τοῦ ἀφθάρτου θεοῦ ἐν ὁμοιώματι εἰκόνος φθαρτοῦ ἀνθρώπου καὶ πετεινῶν καὶ τετραπόδων καὶ ἑρπετῶν.

Romans · 1:20-23

World English Bible

Most people look outward for evidence: the stars, the mountains, the shape of living things. But the one thing you cannot step outside of is yourself. You know it from the inside, which is the closest vantage there is. The verse sets the self beside the earth as a place to look, and then it asks a question rather than giving an order: will you not see? The test is simply whether anything in you needs explaining.

A question for you

Which part of yourself would you most like explained?

If you sayThat I am aware at all
ThenThis is where most careful thinkers begin. Nobody has yet shown how activity in a brain becomes the experience of being someone. No complete answer is known, and the verse does not claim to give one. It asks you to look.
If you sayThat I can love someone
ThenYou did not decide to be able to; you found it already there. The verses keep returning to that kind of fact: not what you built, but what you were given.
If you sayThat I know some things are wrong, unasked
ThenA sense of right that nobody taught is one of the oldest things people have pointed to. This Step comes back to it further on.
If you sayThat I lose myself every night and come back
ThenA daily loss and return that nobody has to work at. This Step comes to it further on.

Part 2 of 4

﴿سَنُرِيهِمْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا فِى ٱلْـَٔافَاقِ وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۗ أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِ بِرَبِّكَ أَنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

We will show them Our signs in the horizons and within themselves until it becomes clear to them that it is the truth.[1402] But is it not sufficient concerning your Lord that He is, over all things, a Witness?[1403]

Translator's notes

[1402] Or "that He (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) is the Truth." [1403] See footnote of 4:79.

Quran · Fussilat 41:53

Translation

May Yahweh our God be with us as he was with our fathers. Let him not leave us or forsake us, that he may incline our hearts to him, to walk in all his ways, and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, which he commanded our fathers. Let these my words, with which I have made supplication before Yahweh, be near to Yahweh our God day and night, that he may maintain the cause of his servant and the cause of his people Israel, as every day requires; that all the peoples of the earth may know that Yahweh himself is God. There is no one else.

Original · Hebrew

יְהִ֨י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֨ינוּ֙ עִמָּ֔נוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה עִם־אֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ אַל־יַעַזְבֵ֖נוּ וְאַֽל־יִטְּשֵֽׁנוּ׃ לְהַטּ֥וֹת לְבָבֵ֖נוּ אֵלָ֑יו לָלֶ֣כֶת בְּכָל־דְּרָכָ֗יו וְלִשְׁמֹ֨ר מִצְוֺתָ֤יו וְחֻקָּיו֙ וּמִשְׁפָּטָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה אֶת־אֲבֹתֵֽינוּ׃ וְיִֽהְי֨וּ דְבָרַ֜י אֵ֗לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֤ר הִתְחַנַּ֨נְתִּי֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה קְרֹבִ֛ים אֶל־יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יוֹמָ֣ם וָלָ֑יְלָה לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת ׀ מִשְׁפַּ֣ט עַבְדּ֗וֹ וּמִשְׁפַּ֛ט עַמּ֥וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל דְּבַר־י֥וֹם בְּיוֹמֽוֹ׃ לְמַ֗עַן דַּ֚עַת כָּל־עַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה ה֣וּא הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים אֵ֖ין עֽוֹד׃

1 Kings · 8:57-60

World English Bible

This verse makes a promise with an 'until' in it. It does not say the signs are already conclusive for everyone. It says they will be shown, outside and in, until it becomes clear to them. That treats clarity as something that arrives over time, as the signs are shown, not something an argument can hand you in a moment. It is a fair thing to test, and it can only be tested by watching for them.

A question for you

How would you know if something were becoming clearer to you?

If you sayI could not unsee it afterwards
ThenThat is how clarity often feels, and it is also how a mistake can feel. The verse speaks of clarity that comes as the signs are shown, which is why watching for them is the part to take seriously.
If you sayMy questions would get better, not louder
ThenA useful sign. Questions that deepen are usually a sign you are getting closer to something, even before you have an answer.
If you sayI would need a way to check
ThenThat is reasonable, and the next verses give you ordinary things to check. None of them needs special belief to look at.

Part 3 of 4

﴿وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquility in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.

Quran · Ar-Rum 30:21

Translation

Yahweh God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”

Original · Hebrew

וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֔ים לֹא־ט֛וֹב הֱי֥וֹת הָֽאָדָ֖ם לְבַדּ֑וֹ אֶֽעֱשֶׂהּ־לּ֥וֹ עֵ֖זֶר כְּנֶגְדּֽוֹ׃

the Torah (Genesis) · 2:18

World English Bible

﴿وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ مَنَامُكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱبْتِغَآؤُكُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And of His signs is your sleep by night and day and your seeking of His bounty. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen.

Quran · Ar-Rum 30:23

Translation

In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, Yahweh, make me live in safety.

Original · Hebrew

בְּשָׁל֣וֹם יַחְדָּו֮ אֶשְׁכְּבָ֪ה וְאִ֫ישָׁ֥ן כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה לְבָדָ֑ד לָ֝בֶ֗טַח תּוֹשִׁיבֵֽנִי׃

the Psalms · 4:8

World English Bible

Two ordinary things. Between husband and wife there can be a settling, a rest, an affection with mercy in it. And every day you sleep, wake, and go out to earn a living. Neither is a proof. Both are things you did not engineer by choice: you did not decide to be able to love, and you do not make yourself fall asleep. The verses call them signs for people who think and who listen, as though evidence were a matter of attention more than of argument.

A question for you

Which of these have you felt as a gift rather than something you made?

If you sayLove between people
ThenThen you already hold one of the signs the verse names, in the place it names it: among yourselves.
If you sayThe rest of sleep
ThenThen the second is yours. Sleep is something everyone shares and no one can produce on command.
If you sayNeither; they feel ordinary
ThenOrdinary is the point of the verse, which asks whether the very ordinariness deserves a second look. You may well decide it does not.

Part 4 of 4

﴿وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا٧ فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا٨﴾

Translation of the meaning

And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it[1932] And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,

Translator's notes

[1932] i.e., balanced and refined it, creating in it sound tendencies and consciousness.

Quran · Ash-Shams 91:7-8

Translation

(for when Gentiles who don’t have the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are a law to themselves, in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience testifying with them, and their thoughts among themselves accusing or else excusing them)

Original · Ancient Greek

ὅταν γὰρ ἔθνη τὰ μὴ νόμον ἔχοντα φύσει τὰ τοῦ νόμου ποιῶσιν, οὗτοι νόμον μὴ ἔχοντες ἑαυτοῖς εἰσιν νόμος· οἵτινες ἐνδείκνυνται τὸ ἔργον τοῦ νόμου γραπτὸν ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις αὐτῶν, συμμαρτυρούσης αὐτῶν τῆς συνειδήσεως καὶ μεταξὺ ἀλλήλων τῶν λογισμῶν κατηγορούντων ἢ καὶ ἀπολογουμένων,

Romans · 2:14-15

World English Bible

You did not learn that cruelty is wrong the way you learned the alphabet. Very young children object to unfairness before they have words for it. The verse says a soul is shaped, and given an inner sense of both what ruins it and what keeps it whole. If so, conscience is not only a rule someone handed you. It is part of the evidence you carry about what you are.

A question for you

When you have done something wrong, how did you know?

If you saySomeone told me
ThenThat happens often, and it is part of how conscience is trained. The verse is about the capacity to recognise it when told.
If you sayI felt it before anyone said anything
ThenThat is the experience the verse points at: an inner sense that arrives ahead of instruction.
If you sayBoth, in different cases
ThenLikely true for most people, and an honest answer. What matters for the question is that the second kind exists at all.

The same in the other books

Translation

The mountains melt like wax at the presence of Yahweh, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth. The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.

the Psalms · 97:5-6

For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of Yahweh’s glory, as the waters cover the sea.
